state.question: Which approved FAQ entry contains a warning or policy statement that needs extra review when simplified?

expected_request.instruction: Create audience-level variants of an approved FAQ. Use only the supplied structured evidence. Produce a concise candidate for human review; never execute, send, publish, certify, grade, or infer causality. Include the exact source_id and source_ref, preserve evidence_quote verbatim, and report context_count exactly. Set faq_id to a concise value grounded in the supplied facts.

content.text: Draft for create audience-level variants of an approved faq: For a general audience, explain the export setting in plain language and retain the warning that shared links remain accessible to their listed recipients. [source_id=MWI-088-A; source_ref=faq/approved/FAQ-88-A]
